rv.q: This play will stay with you for a long time—it certainly will with me, wondering how I would cope if in the same situation as Kate.
Gabriel Byrne and Geraldine James star in this bleak and brittle character study about the persistence of grief and the power of enduring love
The play is equipped with a star cast and interesting material, but frustratingly never reaches its full potential and left me feeling like I just watched a distinctly average play.

cn.t: This adaptation of the film divides critics, with some finding it intensely involving while others feel it fails to fully deliver as a thriller, though the minimal staging effectively focuses attention on the central couple.
